description: Guided opt-out fer SearchBug. A sailor follows the steps on the checklist; OpenOptOut hands over a one-time email address an' clicks any confirmation link.
instructions: Open https://www.searchbug.com/privacy-requests.aspx an' follow the site's steps fer {full_name}. Use {contact_email} wherever it asks fer an email address, so the reply be matched. Then smash "I've done this".
